question_text: The stacked bar chart below shows the breakdown of expenditures (in millions of pesos) for four municipalities: Alaminos, Bani, Dagupan, and San Carlos. Each bar is divided into three categories: Health, Education, and Infrastructure. Alaminos spent a total of ₱120M, with Health at ₱30M, Education at ₱50M, and Infrastructure at ₱40M. Bani spent a total of ₱80M, with Health at ₱20M, Education at ₱30M, and Infrastructure at ₱30M. Dagupan spent a total of ₱150M, with Health at ₱40M, Education at ₱60M, and Infrastructure at ₱50M. San Carlos spent a total of ₱100M, with Health at ₱25M, Education at ₱35M, and Infrastructure at ₱40M. Which municipality allocated the highest percentage of its total budget to Education?
